    a=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    # identify frame color as nonzero color forming largest rectangular border, and inner color
    from collections import Counter
    nz=Counter(x for r in a for x in r if x)
    colors=list(nz)
    # find a solid rectangular border object: use color with bounding box and another color inside
    frame=None
    for c in colors:
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if a[i][j]==c]
        r0,r1=min(i for i,j in pts),max(i for i,j in pts); c0,c1=min(j for i,j in pts),max(j for i,j in pts)
        if r1>r0 and c1>c0 and all(a[i][j]==c for j in range(c0,c1+1) for i in (r0,r1)) and all(a[i][j]==c for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in (c0,c1)):
            frame=(c,r0,r1,c0,c1); break
    if not frame:return a
    fc,r0,r1,c0,c1=frame
    inner=[x for x in colors if x!=fc]
    if not inner:return a
    ic=inner[0]
    # find other connected components of inner color; target components excluding one inside frame
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
      for j in range(w):
       if a[i][j]==ic and (i,j) not in seen:
        st=[(i,j)];seen.add((i,j)); q=[]
        while st:
         p=st.pop();q.append(p)
         for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
          z=(p[0]+di,p[1]+dj)
          if 0<=z[0]<h and 0<=z[1]<w and a[z[0]][z[1]]==ic and z not in seen:seen.add(z);st.append(z)
        comps.append(q)
    for comp in comps:
      if all(r0<i<r1 and c0<j<c1 for i,j in comp): continue
      rr=[i for i,j in comp]; cc=[j for i,j in comp]; tr0,tr1=min(rr)-1,max(rr)+1; tc0,tc1=min(cc)-1,max(cc)+1
      for j in range(tc0,tc1+1):
       if 0<=tr0<h:a[tr0][j]=fc
       if 0<=tr1<h:a[tr1][j]=fc
      for i in range(tr0,tr1+1):
       if 0<=tc0<w:a[i][tc0]=fc
       if 0<=tc1<w:a[i][tc1]=fc
    return a"}
